mg_find_couple_tutor_text: A lot of hidden cards are on the screen. By clicking on them, you open two at a time and try to find identical images. The goal is to find all pairs, opening and remembering their location.
mg_three_in_row_tutor_text: Swap neighboring pieces to collect 3 or more identical pieces in a row. They disappear, and you collect the necessary elements to pass the level.
